purpose: Defensive detection of Go1-style hidden remote-access and persistence patterns.

attribution_policy.known_cve: CVE-2025-2894 is a published Unitree Go1 hidden-functionality issue.
attribution_policy.generic_detection: RogueWatch uses the case to derive generic hidden-access patterns; a match is not proof of malicious intent.
attribution_policy.secrets: Credential values, passwords, API keys, and access tokens are not stored in this pack.

defensive_lessons: Inventory outbound tunnel clients and compare them with documented product features.
Correlate remote-access services with boot persistence and privilege level.
Detect static or embedded authorization material without recording its value.
Flag vendor-controlled remote command paths that bypass local owner approval.
Treat factory Wi-Fi/autoconnect profiles as ingress risk when combined with persistence or broad control capability.
Prefer composite evidence over one keyword or one service name.
Record remediation artifacts so known fixed/removed services are not mistaken for active backdoors.

remediation_provenance.vendor_description: Incremental repair patch that completely removes tunnel services for greater security.
